description: This file defines a PHP class for caching WSDL (Web Services Description Language) instances, including methods for creating cache filenames, retrieving, adding, and removing cached WSDLs, and managing file locks for concurrency control. Additionally, it contains metadata and documentation, as well as class constructors and utility functions.

classes.name: nusoap_wsdlcache
classes.description: A class that caches instances of WSDL objects to improve performance by avoiding repeated network calls.

classes.name: wsdlcache
classes.description: Backward compatibility class alias for nusoap_wsdlcache

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with specified directory and lifetime.

methods.name: createFilename
methods.description: Generates a cache filename based on the WSDL URL.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Appends debug information to the internal debug string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached WSDL instance if available and not expired.

methods.name: obtainMutex
methods.description: Acquires a lock for cache file access.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a WSDL instance in the cache.

methods.name: releaseMutex
methods.description: Releases the lock for cache file access.
